bug_info.bug_desc: The tracer has duplicate dispatch entries for floating-point store instructions (FSW, FSD, FSQ): the first set incorrectly calls printLoadInstr(), while a later set correctly calls printStoreInstr(). Because the earlier case item matches first, the store instructions are formatted as loads, causing the source register (rs2) to be treated as a destination register and producing wrong register names in the trace output. For example, fsd instruction shows x0 instead of the correct floating-point source register fa5.
bug_info.fix_hint: Remove the erroneous earlier FSW, FSD, and FSQ printLoadInstr() dispatch entries so that the existing later printStoreInstr() entries are the only handlers for these floating-point store instructions. This lets the tracer use rs2 as the store source register instead of treating the instruction as a load with a destination register.
